'To whoever tends the light: my boat lost its lamp tonight, and your beam brought us home. We are all alive. Thank you.' It was dated twenty years earlier and signed by a child. That night he lit it early, and kept it burning a little brighter than usual.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒来。路灯在薄雾里投下一圈圈昏黄的光，空荡的街道安静得能听见自己的脚步声。环卫工人推着扫帚走过十字路口，沙沙声像是夜晚最后的呼吸。便利店的灯依旧亮着，玻璃上凝着细小的水珠。远处的高楼只剩零星几扇窗亮着，像不肯入睡的星星。", "w03": "- Recursion is when you solve a job by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- It is like opening a box that has a smaller box inside, again and again, until you find an empty one.\n- The empty box is the stopping point, and then you work back out with the answer."}
